title: Terrible forecast
body: First, let me start by saying I love the layout, ease of use and format of this app. For those reasons I may actually keep using it. So instead of giving it the worst rating I will bump it up to two stars for those reasons. But... The snow forecast is actually terrible. So far this year (and last) it has been so far off that it isn't even marginally reliable. Now, I could forgive this app if it was forecasting the same thing as NOAA and other apps, but they have gone rogue. They typically forecast days where we will receive 6-12 inches of snow. NOAA and others will say 1-2 inches. The others are always right and this has yet to be accurate. Please get the forecast in line with others because what you are using clearly isn't even close. FWIW, I live on the Wasatch back.

title: Best Mountain Weather App of 2020-21
body: I have spent the last 75+ days in the mountains from Colorado, Utah, And the Tahoe area. I actively use 4 apps to chase powder and determine ski conditions each day. This is my number 1 app for 2021. It is by far the most reliable, and they have updated conditions more often than their competitors this season. I believe On the Snow and Open Snow have taken a financial hit due to COVID causing a lack of us skiers/snowboarders paying for their premium services. From my perspective this may be the reason why they are only updating weather once a day and do not have as many weather forecasters. This is my go to app this year and has been great. The services they offer that show the weather at different elevations is brilliant. I have found it to be the most accurate and update multiple times daily. Determining weather in the mountains must be extremely difficult, and the national weather companies towers tend to be below the base of the mountain, therefore they are not accurate for mountain sports. So we need apps such as this to determine conditions when figuring out what base layers to wear each morning and what mountain to head to the following week. Thanks for being the most reliable this year!
